message:
We often think of preparedness in big, daunting terms, but sometimes it's the small wins that truly save the day. That’s why we love resources like the one we found that focuses on essential safety skills. These skills might seem simple, but they can make a world of difference when unexpected situations arise. 🛠️ Taking a little time to learn and practice them can help us respond calmly and confidently.
